title: package.json config.woo
description: Per-plugin settings of the shared WooCommerce plugin tooling. bin/woo-config.sh validates the object against this schema and applies the defaults shown here.

slug.description: Plugin slug: the name of the ZIP, the release asset and the WooCommerce.com or WordPress.org product. Default: the package.json name.

productName.description: Product name for docs and messages. Default: the slug.

js.description: pnpm dependencies and the JavaScript gate (check:js, lint:md:docs).

jsTests.description: pnpm run test:js in the shared plugin-js-lint.yml workflow.

buildTests.description: pnpm run test:build after the package build.

e2e.description: Playwright through bin/e2e.sh and the shared plugin-e2e.yml workflow.

phpunit.description: The shared plugin-phpunit.yml workflow with phpunit.legs.

isolated.description: composer run test:php:isolated in the shared plugin-php-lint.yml workflow.

integration.description: The shared plugin-phpunit.yml workflow with integration.legs (scheduled and manual runs).

qit.description: QIT jobs in manual-ci.yml, ci-cron.yml and ci-cron-qit.yml.

pluginCheck.description: Plugin Check on the candidate ZIP.

testVersion.description: PHP range to check against the packaged files, for example 7.4-8.5.

ruleset.description: Optional PHPCS ruleset using the plugin's locked tools/php-quality dependencies.

root.description: Folder inside the ZIP. Default: the slug.

exclude.description: Exclude list: one zip -x wildcard per line, matched against <root>/<path>; a leading / anchors at the plugin folder; # comments.

build.description: Package script bin/build-zip.sh runs first; empty for none.

composerProduction.description: composer install --no-dev in the staging folder, so vendor/ ships.

php.description: PHP of the CI package job; "system" keeps the runner's PHP.

versionPatterns.description: Version strings besides the main file header. update_version.sh rewrites and check_versions.sh checks each.

pattern.description: Literal text with %s for the version; a leading ^ anchors at the start of a line.

extension.description: QIT extension slug. Default: the slug.

plugins.description: Plugin the QIT activation test installs with the extension (--plugin=<value>), e.g. a required plugin.

derivativeExclude.description: Path removed from the security and PHP compatibility scan copy (e.g. lib/).

projects.description: Playwright projects, one CI job each; "" runs every project in one job.

privatePlugins.description: Runs that can't download private plugins skip specs tagged @integration. A privatePlugins entry with the e2e suite turns this on; set alone, trusted CI runs fail, because E2E no longer gets ORG_DOWNLOADS.

phpInput.description: Whether a requested PHP version replaces the legs' PHP.

scheduledWc.description: WooCommerce version for Cron CI (e.g. trunk); empty keeps latest.

passEnv.description: Environment variables that the shared bin/phpunit.sh passes into the wp-env container when they are set on the host. A plugin with its own PHPUnit runner does not read it.

php.description: PHP versions of the plugin-php-lint.yml coding standards job (composer check:php, bin/hooks/php-lint.sh).

isolatedPhp.description: PHP versions of the plugin-php-lint.yml isolated tests job (capabilities.isolated).

exclude.description: Paths bin/makepot.sh skips (wp i18n make-pot --exclude), on top of the WP-CLI defaults such as node_modules and vendor.

headers.description: POT headers bin/makepot.sh sets (wp i18n make-pot --headers). Keys are written as given.

privatePlugins.description: Private plugin ZIPs that trusted PHPUnit and E2E runs download before checkout: $WOO_PRIVATE_PLUGIN_ZIPS_DIR/<slug>.zip, unzipped to $WOO_PRIVATE_PLUGINS_DIR/<slug>.

source.description: release: <slug>.zip of woocommerce/<slug>'s latest release; all-plugins: product-packages/<slug>/<slug>.zip in woocommerce/all-plugins; wordpress.org: the latest stable WordPress.org ZIP (no token needed).

suites.description: unit and integration: the PHPUnit suites; e2e: bin/e2e.sh prepare (bin/hooks/e2e-prepare.sh).

dirEnv.description: Environment variable that receives the plugin folder.

requireEnv.description: Environment variable set to 1 so tests fail instead of skipping.

minimumPattern.description: Literal text in mainFile with %s for this plugin's minimum supported version, for legs[].plugins minimum and below-minimum.

privatePlugins.description: The E2E and integration suites need privatePlugins in every run: same-repository pull requests download them and run both, fork pull requests skip both with a warning.

readmeChangelog.description: readme.txt carries the changelog (sync at release start, checked by check_versions.sh).

wpOrgSlug.description: WordPress.org slug; empty skips the WordPress.org deploy.

wp.description: latest, previous, minimum or a version.

defaultOnly.description: Run only when no WordPress or PHP version is requested.

plugins.description: Private plugin release per slug: latest, minimum, below-minimum (newest release older than the minimum) or a tag. release-source plugins only.
